card.name: Time units after a number
card.fires_on: Time-span words such as years, hours or months right after a number, or the digit inside a number just before such a unit. Seen in durations, intervals and anniversaries.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: A time unit word follows a count to give a duration or interval.
modes.example: In the morning (10 to 12<< hours>> after the evening dose) on the day

modes.label: Digit before unit
modes.description: A digit inside a number that is about to be followed by years or months.
modes.example: during the previous 1<<2>> months. When women aged 15
